summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper and enum. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds `import enum` and the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, enum.Enum) class with per-member comments; botocore/args.py imports it as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint, makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags), and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (unittest.TestCase base) with one test per behavioral criterion. Verification: test_args.py, test_regions.py and test_client.py pass (413 tests) using the shared venv. Not run: flake8 (not installed), black, isort. A pre-existing line over 79 columns exists at botocore/args.py:315 (also at HEAD). Choices: SDK::Endpoint is always a key, with None when absent; FIPS and DualStack are read via the bridge's private lookup methods; the auto and virtual addressing-style cases share one subTest-based test. Nothing committed.
